tour.title: Project Overview & Architecture
tour.description: Understand CoinTrack's multi-asset wealth management architecture, Docker containerization, and engineering design system.

tour.title: Agent Skills & Quality Standards
tour.description: Explore the packaged agent skills in .agents/skills/, specialist review personas, and standing engineering checklists.

tour.title: Application Bootstrapping & Security Entry Points
tour.description: Explore Spring Boot application bootstrap, SecurityFilterChain definitions, JWT filter interception, and TOTP 2FA verification.

tour.title: Multi-Broker Hexagonal Architecture
tour.description: Examine how CoinTrack abstracts Zerodha Kite, Upstox, and Angel One brokers via hexagonal adapter ports, credential token encryption, and canonical data normalization.

tour.title: Stock Portfolio & Equity Valuation
tour.description: Trace how stock holdings are tracked, trade records are managed, and real-time P&L analytics are computed.

tour.title: Mutual Funds, SIP & AMFI NAV Engine
tour.description: Learn how mutual fund schemes are managed, daily AMFI NAVs are automatically synchronized, and SIP lumpsum transactions are recorded.

tour.title: Financial Calculators & Fixed Income (FD, EPF, PPF, Gold & Silver)
tour.description: Discover CoinTrack's 32 calculation engines (loans, investments, taxes) and multi-asset tracking for Fixed Deposits, EPF, PPF, and Gold/Silver bullion.

tour.title: Next.js Frontend & Terminal Editorial UI
tour.description: Inspect the Next.js App Router presentation layer, featuring the Terminal Editorial aesthetic, TanStack Query data synchronization, and dashboard layouts.
